title: Probation review
summary: Every morning, employees whose probation ends within three weeks get a manager review; the outcome is confirmed, extended or ended and recorded.
description:
Probation review makes sure no probation period ends without a decision. Every morning the scheduler asks your HR system for employees whose probation ends within the look-ahead window (21 days by default).

For each employee it starts the Probation review sub-workflow in the background. The manager gets a task due on the probation end date with a performance rating, a recommendation (confirm, extend or end) and development notes. The Probation outcome decision table turns that into the action, the HR status and any extension; a "confirm" with a below-expectations rating becomes a short extension.

The outcome is written back to the HR system, the people team is emailed the result and next step, and confirmed employees get a congratulations email. Adapt the look-ahead, the outcome rules and the API paths; your HR system should stop returning an employee once their review is recorded so they are not picked up twice.
start: Runs every day at 08:00 UTC (change the time and time zone on the Schedule trigger). It can also be run on demand from the Run dialog.

changelog.notes: Uses the new forms: the manager's probation review has a Submit review button, a grid and a header.

setup: HR system integration: set the base URL and API token. The references expect GET /employees?probation_ends_within=21 (returning data[] with manager and probation_end_date) and PATCH /employees/{id}/probation; adjust them to your HR system.
Assignees: pick the default reviewing manager. To route each review to the real manager, map reviewer_id in the Start probation review step from a field your HR system returns.
Set hr_email on the scheduler to your people team mailbox, and lookahead_days if three weeks is not right.
Edit the Probation outcome rules (extension lengths, HR follow-ups) to your policy.
Email: configure EMAIL_PROVIDER on the instance so the HR and employee emails are delivered (the steps continue on error).

steps.title: Daily check
steps.body: At 08:00 the scheduler lists employees whose probation ends within the look-ahead window.

steps.title: One review each
steps.body: For every employee a Probation review sub-workflow starts in the background, so reviews run independently.

steps.title: Manager review
steps.body: The manager rates performance, recommends confirm, extend or end, and adds development notes before the end date.

steps.title: Decide the outcome
steps.body: The Probation outcome decision table sets the action, the HR status and any extension weeks.

steps.title: Record and tell people
steps.body: The HR system is updated, the people team gets the outcome and next step, and confirmed employees are congratulated.
